peopleconnect.label: Instant Checkmate & TruthFinder
manual: Log in with your email yourself
Enter your birthdate yourself (it can't be changed later)
Set Desired Behavior to Suppressed and click Save

spokeo.label: Spokeo
manual: Search spokeo.com for your name and open your listing
Copy the listing's URL from the address bar and paste it into the URL box
Tick the CAPTCHA and click OPT OUT yourself
Click the confirmation link Spokeo emails you

fastpeoplesearch.label: FastPeopleSearch
manual: In the "I am" list, choose who is making the request yourself
Read the agreement and tick its checkbox yourself
Complete the CAPTCHA and click submit yourself
Click the confirmation link FastPeopleSearch emails you
Pick the record that's you and finish the removal yourself

whitepages.label: Whitepages
manual: Search Whitepages for your own listing yourself
Open the listing that's you and copy its URL
Paste the URL into the suppression form and continue
